programme.title: Mickey 17
programme.desc: The year 2050. Mickey Barnes (Robert Pattinson) takes out a loan on usurious terms.Wanting to escape from an aggressive debt collector, together with his friend Timo (Steven Yeun), he joins the crew of a spaceship that is to colonize the ice planet Niflheim.However, when the second of them becomes a shuttle pilot, Mickey - not entirely consciously - becomes the person assigned to the most dangerous tasks.When he dies, in a process called reprinting, a clone of himself is created, which retains his memories.The situation of the version of man number 17 becomes even more complicated when, contrary to expectations, he is not killed during one of the missions, and when he returns to the ship, he finds Mickey 18 there. In these circumstances, the commander of the expedition, Hieronymous Marshall (Mark Ruffalo), decides to eliminate both of them.A surprising, fast-paced and humorous picture by the Oscar-winning writer and director of "Parasite", Bong Joon Ho.The production is an adaptation of the novel by Edward Ashton.

programme.title: DJ Ahmet
programme.desc: In the Macedonian village of Yuruk, the inhabitants live in accordance with tradition.Young people quickly start families and go on their own.15-year-old Ahmet (Arif Jakup) usually looks after sheep and takes care of his younger brother, but he loves electronic music and would like to become a DJ.To the dismay of his father and the conservative community, he equips his tractor with a sound system.His path crosses with a fellow dancer, Aya, who also dreams of a different life.The girl will soon get married according to her parents' decision.Together they decide to organize a party - as a rebellious act of freedom and self-expression.The feature debut of a creator from North Macedonia, who turned out to be one of the winners of Sundance in 2025.It's a touching story about growing up in a place where techno and tradition do not go hand in hand.

programme.title: Uncharted
programme.desc: New York.Young Nathan Drake (Tom Holland), a descendant of the explorer Francis Drake, works as a bartender in an upscale establishment where he does not hesitate to rob his wealthy customers from time to time.At the same time, the boy believes that he knows where the legendary Eldorado is.One day, he is visited at a bar by experienced treasure hunter Victor "Sully" Sullivan (Mark Wahlberg).The man invites the boy to participate in an expedition to find the treasure of the Portuguese sailor Ferdinand Magellan, who was lost 500 years ago.Together they set off on a crazy and adventurous journey.It soon turns out that they have to hurry, because the ruthless Santiago Moncada (Antonio Banderas) and the mercenary Jo Braddock (Tati Gabrielle) are also looking for the valuables.In addition, the travelers try to find Nathan's missing brother, and because it is sometimes difficult for them to communicate, they learn to cooperate.A spectacular adaptation of a popular video game.

programme.title: King Charles III
programme.desc: After the death of Elizabeth II, her son Charles (Tim Pigott-Smith) takes over power in Great Britain.During his first meeting with Prime Minister Tristan Evans (Adam James), he learns about the draft law regulating the rights of the press, which has already been adopted by both the House of Commons and the House of Lords and is only awaiting the king's consent.Charles refuses to sign it, fearing that the new law will limit press freedom and allow the government to use censorship.Then, due to the prime minister's threat to introduce the law without royal consent, he dissolves parliament.Soon a wave of protests begins to sweep across the country, with the most violent taking place in London.The difficult situation at Buckingham Palace is not improved by a sex scandal involving the ruler's younger son, Prince Henry (Richard Goulding), related to the publication of compromising photos of him with his lover, Jessica (Tamara Lawrance).Charles's older son, William (Oliver Chris), and his wife Catherine (Charlotte Riley) also do not support the king.The young man accuses his father of causing the crisis and demands that he abdicate.A film version of Mike Bartlett's play of the same title.The author is also the author of the script for this production.

programme.title: Half Man
programme.desc: 1980s. The life of bullied teenage Niall (Mitchell Robertson) turns upside down when the son of his mother's partner, the fierce and unpredictable Ruben (Stuart Campbell), comes to live with them for a while.Even though they are not related by blood, over time they both become inseparable.However, subsequent events make them move away from each other.Three decades later, Ruben (Richard Gadd) shows up uninvited at Niall's (Jamie Bell) wedding.It soon becomes clear why he reconnected with his long-lost brother.A suggestive story about the fragility of male relationships, brotherhood, betrayal, loyalty and violence.

programme.title: The Dark Money Game
programme.desc: The filmmakers talk about changes in American law regarding the financing of election campaigns, and examine the boundaries between a political donation and a bribe.In 1975, congress created the Federal Election Commission (FEC), whose task was, among other things,enforcing the law regulating the financing of federal elections.In 2002, a new legal regulation was created, commonly known as the McCain-Feingold Act, which increased the role of private money in running campaigns.A landmark decision, called Citizens United, was issued in 2010 by the US Supreme Court, abolishing all limits on transferring funds to a selected candidate or political party.

programme.title: El bus de la vida
programme.desc: Music teacher Andrés (Dani Rovira) lives in the Basque Country.He is soon diagnosed with cancer, which forces him to often visit the hospital in Bilbao.To get to the facility for treatment, he regularly uses an old bus driven by Mai (Susana Abaitua), who transports him and other cancer patients free of charge.Thanks to conversations with other passengers, the teacher manages to control his fear and look to the future with hope.

programme.title: Down with Love
programme.desc: The 1960s.Writer Barbara Novak (Renée Zellweger) comes to New York to publish her book To Hell with Love.The author convinces women to focus on their careers and treat sex and feelings the same way as men.Editor Vicki Hiller (Sarah Paulson) tries to set her up with the famous journalist, Catcher Block (Ewan McGregor), but none of the several meetings takes place.Eventually, Barbara's book gains popularity and becomes a bestseller.Then the roles are reversed and Novak rejects Block's subsequent proposals to meet.An angry journalist, whom the author called "the worst type of man" in a TV program, decides to take revenge on her.He begins to pose as astronaut Zip Martin to make her fall in love with him and ridicule her theory.He does not know that he himself is becoming an object of manipulation.

programme.title: Unexpected Grace
programme.desc: Teenage Grace (Erica Tremblay) discovers a note from a student looking for new friends.The girl decides to write back, which triggers a chain of events that change the lives of other people.

programme.title: Marmalade
programme.desc: The quiet Baron (Joe Keery) is sent to prison.She shares a cell with Otis (Aldis Hodge), who has escaped several times from prisons.Initially reluctant, the boy agrees to help him get released when the boy offers him $250,000.When asked where he got the money, Baron tells his story.He lived in a small town with his bedridden mother, Eda (Amy Warner).He supported her and himself by working at the post office.However, he lost his job when he refused to cut his hair.Baron's life was changed by the arrival of the hit Marmalade (Camila Morrone), traumatized by her childhood spent in a foster family, in town.Gradually their relationship became closer.Fascinated by the girl, the simple-minded Baron agreed to rob a bank with her, especially since he lacked money to pay for his mother's medicines.Unfortunately, the plan failed because Marmalade started the jump impulsively.In addition, her actions led to a series of tragic events.

programme.title: One of Them Days
programme.desc: Dreux (Keke Palmer) and Alyssa (SZA) are like lovebirds, they have been friends for years and share an apartment.Their everyday lives suddenly turn upside down when they discover that Alyssa's boyfriend has squandered all their savings - money that was supposed to be used to pay the rent.The girls face a real challenge: in an atmosphere full of funny adventures, they must quickly find a way to get the missing amount and avoid eviction.It quickly turns out that they will be forced to take truly unusual actions to not only save their home, but also put their friendship to the test.
